lead.title: The AI boom is now a line item on your next laptop receipt
lead.summary: Memory price trackers show the HBM4 ramp starving commodity DRAM: Samsung and SK Hynix fell below 10 days of finished DRAM inventory on September 7, and HBM3E 36GB 12-Hi stacks listed at $300.87 (+14% year on year) on September 13. A 32GB DDR5 kit that cost $80-120 in early 2025 was near $529 by mid-2026. New fab output from Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron is not expected to bring meaningful relief before mid-2027 or 2028, so plan a local rig budget around sustained memory inflation.

top_stories.title: vLLM AOT config pushes Qwen3.8-27B INT4 to a 147K-token window on one 24GB card
top_stories.summary: A measured recipe posts Qwen3.8-27B (INT4 AutoRound) on vLLM 0.27.1 with an FP8 E4M3 KV cache at a 147,456-token window on a single RTX 3090, hitting about 872 tok/s prefill and 38 tok/s decode against roughly 25-30 tok/s from llama.cpp with MTP. The author notes AOT compilation resolves Inductor/Triton first-startup OOMs, and that GDN linear-attention state pools make vLLM's VRAM estimates unreliable.

top_stories.title: llama.cpp b10946-b10951 add a CUDA F32 fallback and NEMOTRON/MTP load fixes
top_stories.summary: The daily builds in this window make ggml-cuda fall back to F32 on devices without BF16 hardware acceleration (NVIDIA Ampere+, AMD RDNA3/CDNA) and add a zero-divisor guard for the NEMOTRON expert FFN metadata path at load time.

top_stories.title: SutraDB v2.1 ships a pure-Python hybrid vector store with IVF-FLAT ANN for local RAG
top_stories.summary: Version 2.1 is a dependency-light, NumPy-BLAS-accelerated hybrid vector store for on-machine RAG pipelines, adding NumPy acceleration and IVF-FLAT approximate nearest-neighbour search, packaged for Python 3.10-3.12 under MIT.

top_stories.title: AMD's best gaming CPU drops below launch price at $484 with a free 240mm AIO
top_stories.summary: The AMD Ryzen 7 9850X3D landed at $484, under its launch MSRP, in a mid-September deal roundup. The 9800X3D/9850X3D class remains the value pick for CPU-plus-iGPU local inference setups where unified GPU memory is limited.

items.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision Exp arrives as open weights
items.summary: The vision-expert variant of the V4 Flash line is published as open weights (tags: transformers, safetensors, deepseek_v4, image-text-to-text), giving local stacks a multimodal companion to the text-only V4.1-Flash release.

items.title: VibeVoice-ASR-Streaming (1.5B / 7B) keeps climbing the trending charts
items.summary: Microsoft's MIT-licensed streaming ASR family ships open weights with speaker-attributed transcription for 10 languages and custom hotwords, scoring best or tied-best on 12 of 13 attribution benchmarks.

items.title: huawei-bayerlab/marigold-v2-0 initial release mirrored to ModelScope
items.summary: The model card notes the 2026-09-13 ModelScope mirror of the initial Marigold v2.0 release, covering inference, evaluation and training code, the released checkpoints and the demo.

items.title: alibaba/open-code-review open-sources a hybrid deterministic pipeline plus LLM agent
items.summary: The former Alibaba-internal code review assistant arrives with deterministic pipelines plus an LLM agent for line-level comments, multi-language rulesets (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection) and OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoints.

items.title: Kairo routes LLM inference with a fail-closed layer calibrated on RTX 5090 measurements
items.summary: An open-source inference routing layer that fails closed and uses measured RTX 5090 throughput data to route requests, aimed at self-hosted serving stacks such as llama.cpp, vLLM and Ollama.

items.title: MoE / Engram microscope visualises sparse expert activations in the browser
items.summary: A small, local-first visualiser renders expert activation patterns for mixture-of-experts and Engram architectures, letting you inspect sparse-capacity behaviour of local checkpoints without a cloud notebook.

items.title: A local-first interactive LaTeX scratchpad under 15 MB, no server
items.summary: The scratchpad runs entirely in the browser with no backend, fitting offline notebook-style workflows next to locally served models.

items.title: High-end AMD gaming bundle lands under $1,110 for a complete local-inference desktop
items.summary: A 9800X3D bundle pairing an X870E motherboard, 32GB of DDR5, an AIO cooler and a game is listed at $1,109.99 despite ongoing memory inflation. The 32GB DDR5 allotment is the practical starting point for quantized 7B-20B model work on an add-in GPU.

items.title: Mexican cartel crypto farm seized with 300 GPUs in Puebla
items.summary: Federal authorities, the Navy and state police seized roughly 300 GPUs, 80 medium-voltage terminations, a transformer and eight satellite antennas at a clandestine farm in Tlaola, the fourth bust in the region since early last year. Second-hand GPU stock from the 2022 mining era continues to circulate in the used market.

items.title: Tomb Raider runs on a 1-watt ESP32-P4 board for $25
items.summary: An OpenLara port scales to 1,024 x 600 playable pixels on a dual-core 400 MHz ESP32-P4 board drawing about 1 W, showing how little raw compute sub-1B-parameter and vision-class pipelines need at the very low edge.

items.title: AZZA PSAZ-750G reviewed as a budget ATX 3.1 supply for single-GPU inference boxes
items.summary: The 750W ATX 3.1 unit is called adequate for budget builds, relevant where peak-wattage headroom and 12VHPWR4 connector support matter. The review keeps ATX 3.1 as the baseline spec for Blackwell-class cards.
